selection_rule.advance: A candidate passes every checkpoint-2 Core test without infrastructure failure.
selection_rule.conditional: A candidate with at least 0.50 normalized checkpoint-2 Core may receive one second fixed-setting sample.
selection_rule.reject: A candidate below 0.50 normalized checkpoint-2 Core is too hard for strict verified-source sequential feedback.
selection_rule.tie_break: Prefer more all-test headroom, then shorter cumulative public specifications through checkpoint 2.
